description:
PURPOSE: Sends an SMS code to a Polish mobile number to prove the customer owns it, before showing, rescheduling or cancelling their EXISTING bookings.
WHEN TO USE: When the customer asks about their existing booking(s) and no customer_grant is available yet.
WHEN NOT TO USE: Not for a new booking (prepare_booking sends its own code).
REQUIRED: phone. SIDE EFFECTS: sends one SMS (a repeated call within 60 s returns the same verification_id without a new SMS). The response is the same whether or not the number is known.

phone.description: Polish mobile number of the customer

session_id.description: Optional. session_id from the previous result, if you have it. The server also recovers the session from quote_id / slot_id / confirmation_id / customer_grant.

name: start_phone_verification

error.description: Stable machine-readable error id when success=false, e.g. missing_required_fields, unsupported_postcode, no_availability

success.description: true = operation done / data returned; false = see error

title: Weryfikacja numeru
